description: What the catalog schema accepts and refuses, from catalog_fixture.sql: SQL statements, each case rolled back. Any SQLite 3.37 or later must agree.

cases.query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM disks), (SELECT count(*) FROM files), (SELECT count(*) FROM file_chunks), (SELECT count(*) FROM copies), (SELECT count(*) FROM ops), (SELECT count(*) FROM trash), (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs), (SELECT count(*) FROM job_chunks)
SELECT name FROM sqlite_schema WHERE type = 'table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY name
SELECT name FROM sqlite_schema WHERE type = 'index' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY name
SELECT name FROM pragma_table_list WHERE strict = 1 AND schema = 'main' ORDER BY name

cases.note: no chunk_size anywhere: the size is fixed
cases.query: SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_schema WHERE sql LIKE '%chunk_size%'

cases.note: copies and entries are WITHOUT ROWID
cases.query: SELECT name FROM pragma_table_list WHERE wr = 1 AND schema = 'main' ORDER BY name
